brief: The canvas displays an abstract pattern where the rigid structure of a chessboard grid disintegrates and transforms into an organic system of root-like tendrils. These roots, visualized as interconnected, pulsing filaments, spread slowly across the canvas, appearing bioluminescent and ethereal. The underlying texture suggests knitted wool, contrasting with the soft, rhythmic spread of the cyan-to-emerald root network. The piece constantly flows and expands, giving the impression of submerged life in a slow, pulsing tide. There is no required interaction; the viewer simply observes the continuous, autonomous blossoming of the root system.
